features: PANORAMIC 360° SMART MONITORING: Take full control of your security with a motorized 360° Pan and 90° Tilt. This Robot camera ensures total room visibility, allowing you to scan every corner of your home or office directly from your smartphone.

STQC CERTIFIED DATA PROTECTION: Rest easy knowing your video feed is secure. As an STQC Certified device, this camera meets high-level government standards for cybersecurity, ensuring your private moments are protected against unauthorized access.

VIVID COLOR NIGHT VISION: Say goodbye to grainy black-and-white footage. The "All-Time Color" technology uses advanced sensors to deliver bright, full-color video even in complete darkness, helping you identify crucial details 24/7.

AI-POWERED HUMAN TRACKING: Featuring intelligent motion sensors, the camera automatically detects and follows moving persons. Combined with Two-Way Audio, you can listen and talk back to family, pets, or visitors in real-time.

CRYSTAL CLEAR 2-WAY COMMUNICATION: Stay connected with your loved ones or pets from anywhere in the world. The built-in high-sensitivity microphone and powerful speaker allow for fluid two-way audio, making it an ideal choice for a nursery monitor or an elderly care camera.

EASY 3-STEP DIY INSTALLATION: No professional technician required. With its "Plug & Play" design, simply power the camera, connect to your 2.4GHz WiFi via the app, and mount it anywhere—on a table, wall, or ceiling—using the included mounting kit.
